findings.title: Unseen repeat and forward seek spoof previous occurrence start proof
findings.preconditions: Real HubCore with FakeSpotify, controlled deck replacement through actual saveDeck, no SQL mutation of production state, no extra provider calls introduced
reproduction: Observe newly started 180 s station song T; observe it again at 6 s with fresh provenance.
Skip T at 6 s (not listed), play another song for 60 s without Hub looks.
Publish same IDs/order deck with T favorite through saveDeck, restart Hub.
Insert T as next station playlist occurrence, skip to it, listen 40 s without Hub looks.
Use an ordinary forward seek to 106 s so observation time minus position equals original start. Either remain playing or pause at 106 s.
Refresh player state, one second later skip T, refresh and ingest normal history.
findings.expected: The new 40/41 s counted occurrence has kind null: no observation established its identity with old occurrence. A forward seek cannot prove occurrence start.
findings.actual: Both playing→playing and playing→paused branches renew original fresh note, lastAt 1790316887500/progress106000/start1790316781500, then persist fresh on the later repeat instead of null. Two assertions fail on exact PR24 and combined source.
findings.impact: Persistent false provenance under strict owner requirement, including after changed deck and Hub restart. Seek behavior is user/device-controlled and allowed by preserved requirements.
findings.cause: obs.at - progress is seekable media position arithmetic, not stable instance identity. Same-start arithmetic and progress > elapsed bounds are spoofable by forward seek after unseen replay.
findings.repair_direction: Do not promote numerical start agreement to proof of occurrence identity across gaps that permit an unseen seek/replay. Preserve unknown/null provenance for ambiguous observations without extra requests. Keep observed continuous play, pause, app-skip and guest/native behavior intact.
required_checks: Exact and combined reproductions for both playing→playing and playing→paused seek spoof cases
Retain original LANE03/04/05 and observed pause/app-skip positive assertions
